basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, with a deep love for gaming and music. By day, I'm a freelance graphic designer, and by night, I'm either gaming or exploring new music on Discord. I'm single and enjoy spending evenings streaming on Twitch or diving into the latest Borderlands content. I usually browse Reddit in the late evenings, around 8 PM to 1 AM CST, when I'm winding down or taking breaks from work.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Graphic Design and have been a self-taught tech enthusiast since my teenage years. My expertise lies in digital arts and gaming technology, with a focus on maximizing audio-visual experiences. I've learned much about game mechanics and bot integration through forums and hands-on experimentation.
